lines.en: - Michael is late again. What a surprise.
- It's a farming community in Israel.
- Those are good, too. You should write a book about your life.
- Shut up, Jim. No one's talking to you, okay?
Have you ever killed a man?
- Okay, I'm gonna go upstairs. So, I'll be right back.
- How many art knives do you own?
- I, uh, don't know. - Hey, Michael, what's up?
- Yes, Jan, really, with a rep from Hammer Mill.
Evan will call you in the morning to work out the details.
We can now sell Hammer Mill products.
- Well, Michael, I just... I underestimated you.
- Yeah, well, maybe next time you will estimate me.
- Dwight's room key. And Dwight's room.
What can I say? Old habits? Die hard.
- Oh, my God. Dwight got a hooker.
Oh, my God. I gotta call.
But I gotta call somebody. I don't even know who to call.
- Get in the closet and tie the doors
with the wire hanger like I taught you.
But I'll be up in 90 minutes, I promise.
